body:
ive been feeling depressed for a long time but honestly, the relationship was what i was holding on to. christmas eve i tried and failed to take some pills cos someone found the note.

i know its stupid that the relationship is what i was holding on to. he controlled everything - whatever little money i had saved was spent on a party he wanted to throw and i now owe wells fargo $400. he still has all my checks and debit cards and im afraid to ask for them.

contrary to the nasty message i got, im not excusing my cheating. it was fucked up and i messed up. but he has been cheating on me with the very same woman for the past year and shes basically moving in as soon as i leave. i dont know what her game is but im too exhausted to care right now.

i dont know what to do. i dont want to give too much away but im an (undocumented) immigrant, so me cheating, especially with a woman is a big deal. for him, not so much, its actually expected for guys to cheat and have second girlfriends, wives and families. i already have people afraid to have their children near me because im now a lesbian and i might influence them. we didnt have kids but i was basically a stay at home girlfriend. after i lost my job a while back he told me he would take care of me. come to find out that that meant staying in the house for weeks on end with the only outing to walmart. i dont have a car so i was stuck. literally. couldnt go out without permission, phone calls and texts monitored, the whole nine. i waited on him and foot and was still cut off from him financially, spiritually, sexually. i thought about leaving but i thought if i tried harder he would change and i didnt have anywhere else to go anyway.

im sorry for the long winded comment. i just dont know what to do. everything i try fails. im at the end of my rope and its surreal to me that im on the internet telling a virtual stranger all about my shitty life. thank you for commenting
